Data centre interactions with the electricity grid
Is there a risk of delays in connecting data centres to the grid?
The global expansion of data centre capacity faces risks from grid connection delays,
particularly in regions experiencing high concentrations of demand growth. Connection
queues for new data centres can already be long in many key regions (
years, several jurisdictions have placed moratoriums on new data centres while system
